statement.zh: **协议**：EAP-TLS（EAP-TLS）。摘要与 §1 给出同一界定：「This document defines EAP-TLS, which includes support for certificate-based mutual authentication and key derivation.」即它是 EAP 框架下的一个具体方法，把 TLS 用作认证与密钥派生的内核。
statement.en: **Protocol**: EAP-TLS (EAP-TLS).The abstract and §1 give the same definition: "This document defines EAP-TLS, which includes support for certificate-based mutual authentication and key derivation." It is one concrete method inside the EAP framework, with TLS as its core.

statement.zh: 双向认证依靠证书：§2.2 Identity Verification 写明「As part of the TLS negotiation, the server presents a certificate to the peer, and if mutual authentication is requested, the peer presents a certificate to the server.」。
statement.en: Mutual authentication rests on certificates: §2.2 says "As part of the TLS negotiation, the server presents a certificate to the peer, and if mutual authentication is requested, the peer presents a certificate to the server."。.

statement.zh: 部署侧的硬要求是吊销检查：§5.4 规定「EAP-TLS peer and server implementations MUST support the use of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs)」，并指向 RFC 3280 的相关小节。§2.1.4 的强制只针对支持隐私的场景：此类服务端「MUST request a client certificate」，并非无条件要求客户端证书。
statement.en: The hard deployment requirement is revocation checking: §5.4 states that implementations "MUST support the use of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs)" The §2.1.4 mandate is scoped to privacy support, where servers "MUST request a client certificate" — client certificates are not required unconditionally.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 保护范围有边界：§5.5 指出「The integrity protection of EAP-TLS packets does not extend to the EAP header fields (Code, Identifier, Length) or the Type or Flags fields.」§5.1 的安全声明表还把信道绑定记为「Channel binding:」后的 No。本文以 TLS 1.0 及以后为基线，并在 §5.1 的脚注里写明「EAP-TLS inherits the secure ciphersuite negotiation features of TLS, including key derivation function negotiation when utilized with TLS v1.2 [RFC4346bis]」。
statement.en: The protection has edges: §5.5 notes "The integrity protection of EAP-TLS packets does not extend to the EAP header fields (Code, Identifier, Length) or the Type or Flags fields." and the §5.1 claims table records channel binding as No.The baseline is TLS version 1.0 or later, and a footnote in §5.1 adds that "EAP-TLS inherits the secure ciphersuite negotiation features of TLS, including key derivation function negotiation when utilized with TLS v1.2 [RFC4346bis]"; TLS 1.3 is not addressed.

statement.zh:
RFC 5216（2008 年 3 月，Standards Track，作者 Simon、Aboba、Hurst）头部标注「Obsoletes: 2716」，§1 说明「While this document obsoletes RFC 2716 [RFC2716], it remains backward compatible with it.」；§2.3 记录密钥来源：「In EAP-TLS, the MSK, EMSK, and Initialization Vector (IV) are derived from the TLS master secret via a one-way function.」文中没有 Updates 行，也未更新 RFC 3748。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：EAP-TLS的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: RFC 5216 (March 2008, Standards Track, Simon, Aboba and Hurst) carries “Obsoletes: 2716” and says in §1 that "While this document obsoletes RFC 2716 [RFC2716], it remains backward compatible with it." Section 2.3 records the key origin: "In EAP-TLS, the MSK, EMSK, and Initialization Vector (IV) are derived from the TLS master secret via a one-way function." There is no Updates line and no update to RFC 3748.
